business_problem: AT&T needed to simplify a costly on-prem Hadoop-based data environment so thousands of users could get faster, self-service access to enterprise metrics and reporting without sacrificing performance, while hundreds of petabytes of telecom data continued to grow.
solution_summary: AT&T migrated its myRESULTS reporting environment and broader analytics estate to Snowflake Telecom Data Cloud to create a cloud-native single source of truth. Snowflake's separation of storage and compute let the team deploy new features for specific business units without affecting others, while stored procedures pinned to dedicated virtual warehouses gave the Java-based front end predictable performance for different API workloads. The platform now unifies data from headquarters, call centers, retail locations, vendors, and executive teams into one analytics application with more than 2,700 metrics and 230 APIs. Because Snowflake absorbs concurrency and caching more efficiently than the prior system, AT&T can answer most user queries in under a second while cutting operating costs. That combination of faster launches, lower complexity, and scalable self-service analytics gives business teams quicker access to operational and customer insights across the company.
